profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at Tesla
profile.summary:
- 17+ years of strong experience in complete Software Development Life Cycle in various roles including Technical Lead, Project Lead and Architect.
- Experience working in an agile environment using Scrum methodologies and Scaled Agile (SAFe).
- Strong Technical Background with diverse experience with Healthcare, Cloud-based apps, Multi-Tenant Apps, Java/J2EE based Enterprise Systems, Micro Services and Multi-Tier Web applications.
- Experience with building the Cloud healthcare platform services
- In depth knowledge of solution architectures, identity management system, frameworks, business components, middleware and security controls to help drive the non-functional requirements.
- Highly self-motivated professional with ability to do self-learning of new processes, technologies, articulate business/technical problems, and work in a mixed team environment.

positions.title: Manager/Architect Development Engineering | R&D - Philips HealthSuite Digital Platform
positions.description:
- Taking on the Architecture role to build the next generation of cloud based Philips Health Suite Digital Platform to enable the development of healthcare and health-related applications. 
- Design platform component services: Identity & Access management, Telemetry Observation Storage, logging, auditing, wellness data collector, IHE Profiles. 
- Research and evaluate new technologies.
- Design and prototype software.
- Provide software development guidelines (Java, Spring, REST, Web Services, Sonar, Fortify) and software development best practice.
- Provide design guidelines to build platform Micro-Services which are deployed in the Cloud Foundry.
- Research and perform proof of concept on the new technologies.  
- Perform code review, review low level designs and REST APIs specification provided by Development teams.
- Work closely with developers to ensure implementation is aligned with high level design.
- Analyzed system performance metrics and provided approach to improve performance
- Work closely with Architects across programs to help drive software solutions.
- Work closely with Product Managers to capture requirements and functionalities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Work on health information exchange profiles (IHE XDS, XCPD, XCA, PDQ, PIX)
- Work on health information exchange cloud-based applications.
- Work on web services orchestration for health information exchange.

positions.title: Project Lead Development
positions.description:
- Developed Defense Biometric Identification System application. Tasks include software components integration, software updates, new version and patch release, ensure software quality, improve user interface, implement new features requirements. 
 - Designed and developed an enterprise .Net Web service to manage military personnel records across regions.
 - Designed and developed military access management application.
 - Current position involves working together with different group of software developers, DBA, system engineers and technical support personnel.

positions.title: Web Service Developer
positions.description:
- Developed Web services using XML-RPC to allow remote access, files/folders sharing and share management among owners and users of company’s Personal Backup Server product.
 - Developed Web services interface using JSP, Servlet and Java beans. 
 - Developed Services Administrative page for internal usage

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Research on Security and Privacy related issues of Semantic Web Services.
 - Create ontology to describe future Security and Privacy of Semantic Web Services. 
 - Implemented Security Web Services for Encryption, Decryption and Signature of XML, SOAP messages and text using Java, Visual Studio.Net C# and Oracle.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed multithreaded client/server Windows based scanner’s applications to capture fingerprint and handprint through 1394 Firewall.
 - Developed remote applications to transfer and receive images/bitmaps from a live finger/hand scanner. Works included bitmaps palette indexes extraction and sending images/bitmaps across 1394 channel.
 - Software development experiences using scanner’s firmware and 1394 Firewall driver.
 - Developed SDK software based on customer’s requirement and responsible for SDK update, documentation, and release.
 - Windows GUI development work included finger/hand image capturing window.
 - Worked closely with manufacture to provide technical support and new features update.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
- Developed custom applications to perform automated testing of electronic parts based on customer requirements using LabWindows/CVI and Visual C++. 
 - Developed a PXI systems test for stand-alone testing and engineering evaluation as well as a panel test station to test four AccessLink II two-way pager transceiver board boards in a pneumatic fixture.
 - Developed a controller system to test IBM disk drive components in a stress evaluation environment under National Instruments CVI test development environment using NI-DAQ and four-port serial control.
 - Provided consultation and helped developing client/server controller test system to perform stress testing on hard drivers, Ethernet cards, wireless cards. Companies consulted included Maxim, Wireless Access, IBM, and Plato Labs.
 - Created efficient GUI application to provide a simple test environment. 
 - Responsible for application new features support and troubleshooting.
